name: Runtime Identity & Provenance Epoch
intent: Bind durable runtime semantics to one monotonic local provenance epoch without allowing model/component replacement to replace iKant identity or create authority.

runtime_reticulum.flow: material -> material_sha256 -> append_only_epoch_ledger -> compact_runtime_epoch -> cycle/config/surface/enduser projections

decisions.decision: Use deterministic material identity plus monotonic ledger ordinal.
decisions.reason: A process restart with identical verified components must not create a new epoch; A->B->A must remain three historical epochs.

decisions.decision: Require verified S5 managed binding before managed TURN cognition.
decisions.reason: Epoch provenance must constrain the causal boundary, not merely decorate a later projection.

decisions.decision: Treat ledger hashes as local integrity only.
decisions.reason: No signing/attestation supply chain exists; actor authenticity and SLSA attestation are not claimed.

decisions.decision: Keep identity label iKant locale stable across component swaps.
decisions.reason: The replaceable language model is subordinate runtime provenance, not the agent identity.

decisions.decision: Reconcile material corrective Git history in Product Contract.
decisions.reason: A self-consistent constitutional registry that omits merged PR47/S15bis is materially incomplete.

falsification_log.finding: Including live process status in epoch material makes harmless engine restart look like identity replacement.
falsification_log.resolution: live_status excluded from material digest and explicitly projected as non-identity.

falsification_log.finding: Reusing an S16 stable cache from a prior component epoch during RUNNING mixes two semantic bases.
falsification_log.resolution: NONBLOCKING_EPOCH_REBASE_REQUIRED overlay refuses the stale base while preserving TURN liveness.

falsification_log.finding: A config receipt can be locally intact but belong to a prior epoch.
falsification_log.resolution: receipt projection distinguishes CURRENT, PRIOR_KNOWN, UNATTESTED and UNKNOWN bindings.

falsification_log.finding: S16bis test encoded FND-002 as permanently OPEN.
falsification_log.resolution: historical oracle now requires CLOSED once S15bis is constitutionally reconciled.

non_claims: No production reliability estimate from modeled saturation.
